A specialised consultancy engaged in base metals market and price analysis, focusing in particular on copper.
Our analysis and advice relates to all sectors of the industry from mine to a thorough and detailed coverage of 
end markets for products containing base metals.
With 20 years market leadership, our clients include mining companies, metals processors, fabricators, traders, 
financial institutions, industry bodies and legal firms. 
We have a team of consultants who are skilled interviewers and our network of experts enables us to provide 
our clients with local insights on topics that matter.
       
    
         
   Base Metals Consultancy
► 
Fundamental supply-demand market analysis
► 
Intermediate product market dynamics & pricing
►        Fabricated product market dynamics & pricing
►        Fabricated product project appraisals
►

► 
End market analysis by product and sector
► 
Smelting, refining & fabricating project appraisals

C O P P E R 
BME
                          COPPER QUARTERLY REPORT
Visit www.bmecopper.com or contact: reports@intierra.com
The Copper Quarterly Report is the key product for any serious analysis of copper market fundamentals looking 
at the medium and long term future. It is the only commercially available report covering the copper supply chain 
end-to-end and within the context of developments and the financials of major mining companies.
         
       
    
         
•   An editorial review, five-year data history and forecasts of the physical copper market fundamentals and prices. 
•   Leading Market Players - review of developments, output and financial performance. 
•   A news round up of mining, smelting & refining and copper fabrication for the previous three months. 
•    Summary tables showing capacity, output, trade and stocks of refined copper products and all other products globally.
•   Detailed country and region tables covering 70 countries; showing production capacities and all process chain items.
•   An Excel Client File containing the full CopperChain data set; currently covering the years 2000 to 2016.
•   BME Copper Concentrates Weekly Update and Weekly Market Review Reports.
•   Weekly Review of Developments in Base and Precious Metals.
•   Email access to the Editor to answer your queries.
       Summarised features of the report:
The Copper Quarterly Report is an annual subscription service. You may also be interested to subscribe to the 
Monthly Copper Briefing Report which focuses on short term analysis of the copper market fundamentals.
        Benefits
         
         For more than a decade, the report has been the most respected source of copper data and forecasts. Providing 
         thorough analysis of physical market fundamentals, showing copper’s transition through all stages of the process 
         chain and identifying changes in the factors influencing copper prices. 
        ►   Track stock changes at each stage of the supply chain.
        ►   Track and compare global output performance with mine and processing capacities across regions via 
               direct access to detailed historical and forecast data.  
       
        ►   Gain indepth knowledge of major producers and consumers of copper.
        ►   Monitor and identify trend developments through historical review of the copper market.
        ►   Update and review the leading Market Players and the most recent global copper news.
        ►   Make informed business decisions with pricing information, five-year forecasts and the full CopperChain 
               data set; outlining pertinent data and predictions from year 2000 to 2016.
        ►   Use our data to complement, update or customise your own market analysis and forecasts.
